translation.name: Boots of Agility
profile: The Boots of Agility provide a direct increase to Agility and may be an unobtrusive part of someone's personal equipment. In the story, they may be worn by an experienced scout, dancer, or adventurer who needs more assured movement. Their origins and appearance add interest to the character without granting a separate ability to walk on water, fly, or automatically overcome any obstacle.

Higher Agility applies to activities and calculations that use this attribute under the rules. The bonus does not guarantee success and does not separately increase every weapon's attack directly. The hero must still consider the situation, surface, and their own plan. When choosing equipment, distinguish a general attribute bonus from magical tools designed for a narrow purpose.

It uses the "Feet" slot and the base item is "boots". The listed bonus is +1 AGI. The item has no other explicitly listed requirement. Its catalog value is 20 gp. Follow the calculation and conditions of the bonus exactly; its origins in the story alone grant no additional abilities.

strings.Přesný řádek této položky má přednost př: This item's exact entry overrides the general formula only where explicitly stated. Vaelor does not add any further hidden bonuses.
